items.title: Patience and Prayer
items.text: Seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.

items.title: Best Among You
items.text: The best among you are those who have the best manners and character.

items.title: Remember Allah
items.text: Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.

items.title: Actions by Intentions
items.text: Actions are judged by intentions, and each person will have what they intended.

items.title: Speak Good or Stay Silent
items.text: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.

items.title: Reliance on Allah
items.text: And whoever relies upon Allah, then He is sufficient for him.

items.title: Mercy to Others
items.text: The merciful are shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on earth.

items.title: Do Good
items.text: Indeed, Allah loves the doers of good.

items.title: Strong Believer
items.text: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer.

items.title: Forgiveness
items.text: And let them pardon and overlook. Would you not like that Allah should forgive you?

items.title: Smiling is Charity
items.text: Your smile for your brother is charity.

items.title: Justice
items.text: Indeed, Allah commands justice, excellence, and giving to relatives.

items.title: Allah Looks at Hearts
items.text: Allah does not look at your appearance or wealth, but He looks at your hearts and deeds.

items.title: Gratitude
items.text: If you are grateful, I will surely increase you.
